title: Kitchen and Orchard
author: Oscar Delacroix
blurb: Ines Vane, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, has spent three years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
